summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Talismans
summary.text: Catalog entries 114–135 from a Florentine astrological codex, covering omens about sought matters, absent persons, travel, parents, foreign residence, building, ships, war, judgment, planetary motion, and fixed-star talismans. Entry 134 attributes astrological interpretations to Antiochus; entry 135 concerns the effects of fixed stars’ epochs.
